title: What is lazy loading and eager loading in Entity Framework Core?
description: Understand different data loading strategies in EF Core.

data.text: **Question:** What is lazy loading and eager loading in Entity Framework Core?
Lazy loading loads related data only when accessed. Eager loading loads related data upfront using Include(). Explicit loading loads related data manually after the main query.

**Lazy Loading:**
- Related data loaded automatically when accessed
- Requires navigation properties marked virtual
- Can cause N+1 query problem
- Simple but potentially inefficient
- Example: Accessing blog.Posts triggers a new query

**Eager Loading:**
- Related data loaded upfront with Include()
- Single query with JOIN
- Better performance for known needs
- Explicit control over what loads
- Example: context.Blogs.Include(b => b.Posts)

**Explicit Loading:**
- Manual loading after main query
- Uses Entry().Collection()
- Conditional loading
- Example: context.Entry(blog).Collection(b => b.Posts).LoadAsync()

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Lazy loads on access, eager loads upfront
data.takeaway: Choose loading strategy based on data needs: eager for known relationships, lazy for optional, explicit for conditional.
